title: Verizon Raises Full-Year Outlook and Signs $2B AI Deal With Amazon
summary:
Verizon reported third-quarter adjusted earnings per share of $1.31, exceeding analyst estimates of $1.27 to $1.28, and signed an AI infrastructure partnership with Amazon Web Services valued at more than $2B. During the quarter, the carrier added 406,000 postpaid phone subscribers, nearly double the 209,000 analysts had projected.

The company raised its full-year adjusted EPS guidance to a range of $5.04 to $5.06, up from its previous forecast of $4.99 to $5.04. Verizon also increased its annual target for postpaid phone additions to between 1.1M and 1.2M. Third-quarter revenue of $34.3B fell short of estimates, which ranged from $34.74B to $34.76B.
